summary: NOV Inc. filed an 8-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders (Item 5.07) and declaring a regular quarterly dividend of $0.09/share plus a supplemental dividend of $0.09/share (Item 8.01). The shareholder vote ratified director elections, auditor appointment, and advisory say-on-pay. There is no special situation — the dividends are ordinary-course capital returns, not a transformative capital return event.
